metrics.name: net_revenue
metrics.numerator: base charge minus line discount plus line fee adjustments for billable lines
metrics.clock: checkout date, falling back to no published daily row when checkout is absent
metrics.null_policy: missing fee total is zero; required price inputs must be non-null

metrics.name: utilization_rate
metrics.denominator: sum of available units plus rented units
metrics.null_policy: return null when serviceable units sum to zero

metrics.name: on_time_return_rate
metrics.numerator: completed rentals returned at or before expected return timestamp
metrics.denominator: completed rentals with a return outcome
metrics.clock: event timestamps in the synthetic source timezone
metrics.null_policy: return null when there are no completed rentals

metrics.name: active_rental_count
metrics.grain: rental lifecycle as of an explicitly supplied timestamp
metrics.numerator: count of checked-out rentals not yet returned at the as-of timestamp
metrics.exclusions: cancelled rentals and reservations not yet checked out
metrics.null_policy: missing checkout means not active; missing return means still active after checkout
